WITH meal_rates AS (
    SELECT s.CDSCode,
           s.School AS school_name,
           s.Charter AS charter,
           s.GSserved AS grades_served,
           1.0 * f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" /
               NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS free_meal_rate
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'
      AND (TRIM(s.GSserved) = '12' OR TRIM(s.GSserved) LIKE '%-12')
), top_schools AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, school_name, charter, grades_served, free_meal_rate
    FROM meal_rates
    WHERE free_meal_rate = (SELECT MAX(free_meal_rate) FROM meal_rates)
), results AS (
    SELECT m.school_name, m.free_meal_rate, m.charter, m.grades_served,
           t.AvgScrRead + t.AvgScrMath + t.AvgScrWrite AS sat_total
    FROM top_schools AS m
    LEFT JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = m.CDSCode
)
SELECT school_name,
       ROUND(free_meal_rate, 4) AS free_meal_rate,
       CASE charter WHEN 1 THEN 'Yes' WHEN 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS charter_school,
       grades_served,
       CASE
           WHEN sat_total IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
           WHEN sat_total < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
           WHEN sat_total <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
           ELSE 'Above Average'
       END AS sat_performance_level
FROM results
ORDER BY school_name;
```

WITH RECURSIVE months(month_start) AS (
    SELECT '2010-01-01'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT date(month_start, '+1 month')
    FROM months
    WHERE month_start < '2010-12-01'
), monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT date(pl.CreationDate, 'start of month') AS month_start,
           COUNT(DISTINCT p.Id) AS post_count
    FROM postLinks AS pl
    JOIN posts AS p ON p.Id = pl.RelatedPostId
    WHERE pl.CreationDate >= '2010-01-01'
      AND pl.CreationDate < '2011-01-01'
      AND p.AnswerCount <= 2
    GROUP BY date(pl.CreationDate, 'start of month')
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(mc.post_count, 0)), 2) AS average_monthly_posts
FROM months AS m
LEFT JOIN monthly_counts AS mc ON mc.month_start = m.month_start;
```

    SELECT ID, FG, TRIM("U-PRO") AS protein
    FROM Laboratory
)

      OR CAST(CASE WHEN l.protein LIKE '>=%' THEN SUBSTR(l.protein, 3)
                   ELSE l.protein END AS REAL) >= 300
  );

WITH protein_results AS (
    SELECT ID, TRIM("U-PRO") AS result
    FROM Laboratory
), protein_amounts AS (
    SELECT ID,
           TRIM(CASE
               WHEN result GLOB '>=*' THEN SUBSTR(result, 3)
               WHEN result GLOB '+[0-9](*)' THEN SUBSTR(result, 4, LENGTH(result) - 4)
               ELSE result
           END) AS amount
    FROM protein_results
)
SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l.LDH >= 500
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM protein_amounts AS u
    WHERE u.ID = p.ID
      AND u.amount GLOB '[0-9]*'
      AND u.amount NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*'
      AND u.amount NOT GLOB '*.*.*'
      AND CAST(u.amount AS REAL) >= 100
)
ORDER BY p.ID;
```
